column1: Power and control circuit on several pages: main switch, motor protection, three contactors with interlocks, on-delay timer, interruption points, potentials with wire colours, motor cable and cable reports.

column1: Fluid power and electrics in one project: pneumatic circuit with service unit, valve terminal, 5/2 valves, flow control valves and cylinders; solenoid coils and position switches are linked to the valves and cylinders.

column1: Plant structure after IEC 81346 (functions and locations), page sections, single-line diagram, a pump direct on line and one with frequency converter, PLC cards with digital and analog channels, a sensor plug and the PLC assignment.
